methodologyNotes: Re-verified each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-15/18 (route4me.com/pricing, optimoroute.com/pricing/, routific.com/pricing/, onfleet.com/pricing, badgermapping.com/pricing/, track-pod.com/pricing-delivery-app/, route-manager.com/pricing/, elogii.com/pricing, routal.com/en/pricing). MATERIAL CORRECTION: Circuit for Teams was rebranded to Spoke Dispatch; getcircuit.com/teams/pricing now 301-redirects to spoke.com/dispatch/pricing (direct fetch 403). The draft's Circuit plan names (Starter/Essential/Standard/Pro) and prices ($100/$250/$500/$750) are outdated/incorrect and do not match the current product. The current Spoke Dispatch structure (Starter $125/1,000 stops, Premium $200/2,000 stops, Expert $1,000/12,000 stops) was corroborated from two independent 2026 sources (WebSearch + Capterra) and is now used. Routal prices are EUR-only; USD equivalents are unavailable so monthlyUsd is null. eLogii, WorkWave RouteManager360, OptimoRoute Custom, Track-POD Enterprise and Routal Enterprise are quote-only with no published fixed price, so monthlyUsd is null. All accessedAt = 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Route4Me
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched route4me.com/pricing on 2026-06-15. Three flat monthly tiers confirmed at $199/$299/$349. No per-driver or annual-discount pricing listed. A limited app-only 'free' allowance (10 stops on mobile apps) exists but is not a full forever-free plan; freeTier kept false. HIPAA available via sales but no public certification page found.

plans.name: Route Optimization
plans.notes: Route planning, single and multi-driver optimization, real-time GPS tracking, dispatch, voice navigation, proof of delivery. Add-ons (recurring routing, curbside, commercial vehicle) at extra cost.

plans.name: Business Optimization
plans.notes: All Route Optimization features plus multi-driver/multi-vehicle optimization, mixed fleet, territory management, dynamic reoptimization, advanced analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise Optimization
plans.notes: All Business features plus custom algorithms and APIs, professional services (remote and on-site), strategic network planning, tailored onboarding. Best for large fleets.

limits: No per-driver seat limit stated on public pricing
Add-ons (recurring routing, commercial routing) billed separately
App-only free allowance limited to 10 stops
keyFeatures: Mixed fleet and commercial vehicle routing
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page re-fetched directly; three flat tiers confirmed. No SOC2/HIPAA certification page accessible.

vendors.name: OptimoRoute
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched optimoroute.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-15. Lite $35.10/driver/mo and Pro $44.10/driver/mo confirmed (billed annually, 10% discount stated; ~$39/~$49 month-to-month). Custom is quote-only (monthlyUsd null). GDPR confirmed; OptimoRoute is also SOC 2 Type I certified per WebSearch, but soc2 left null pending a direct trust-page citation.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: $35.10/driver/month billed annually. Up to 700 orders at once. Mobile app, route history, Excel/Garmin exports, unlimited planning, live tracking, API, live ETA. ~$39/driver/month month-to-month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $44.10/driver/month billed annually. Up to 1,000 orders at once. Adds analytics, weekly planning, real-time order tracking, proof of delivery, customer feedback. ~$49/driver/month month-to-month.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Quote only. Thousands of orders at once. Adds pickup/delivery, multi-day routes, commercial routing, dynamic depots, technical consulting, expert support.

limits: Lite: up to 700 orders at once
Pro: up to 1,000 orders at once
Custom: thousands of orders
keyFeatures: Per-driver pricing scales with fleet size
Proof of delivery and customer feedback (Pro+)
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page re-fetched directly. GDPR confirmed via privacy policy. SOC 2 Type I evidence noted but left null pending official trust-center source.

vendors.name: Routific
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched routific.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-15. Free plan up to 100 orders/month confirmed. Single paid plan $150/mo flat for 101-1,000 orders, then per-order overage scaling $0.15 down to $0.03 across volume bands (custom above 50,000). Per-order model (not per-driver); unlimited drivers/dispatchers on all tiers. Overage range corrected to $0.03-$0.15 (matches official bands).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 100 orders/month. All features except SMS notifications. Unlimited drivers and dispatchers, route optimization, GPS tracking, email notifications, proof of delivery.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 101-1,000 orders/month at $150 flat. Unlimited drivers and dispatchers. SMS notifications are a paid add-on. Above 1,000 orders: per-order overage scaling from $0.15/order (1,001-2,000 band) down to $0.03/order (20,001-50,000 band); custom above 50,000.

limits: Free: 100 orders/month
Paid base: 1,000 orders/month then per-order overage
SMS notifications cost extra
keyFeatures: Unlimited drivers and dispatchers on all plans
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page re-fetched directly. Order-based model confirmed; overage bands verified.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting at $3,099/month. 10,000+ tasks/month. Adds multi-brand/multi-region support, enhanced branding, enterprise SSO, lifetime historical reporting, premium support.

limits: Launch: 2,500 tasks/month
Scale: 5,000 tasks/month
Enterprise: 10,000+ tasks/month
enrichment.provenance: Pricing re-fetched directly. HIPAA/BAA confirmed via official Onfleet HIPAA Compliance support article.
